subject: Proposed Budget Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a revised draft of the proposed budget ordinance submitted by the administration, which focuses on the general fund and establishes key annual budget milestones. The committee voted to share the relevant section with the School Committee for feedback and kept the paper in committee.

items.title: Proposed Budget Ordinance (Paper 22-494)
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian and Finance Director Bob Dickinson presented an updated draft setting an April 15 start for preliminary budget hearings and a March 1 target for school budget allocations, while deferring enterprise and special revenue funds to future iterations. The subcommittee voted to refer the school allocation provision and draft materials to the School Committee for input, requested councilors submit written comments by the following week, and kept the paper in committee.
